fields.missing: quiet NaN when absent or not yet available
fields.known_non_pit_fields: Refused when declared; retain honest source qualifications rather than emptying the list.

axis.securities: strictly increasing nonzero u64 security IDs
axis.membership: exact role member.u8; golden all_common alignment is separately audited

boundaries.resolution: Never alter a consumer seal. Use a separately pinned pre2023 role for release evaluation and smoke. Runtime executable contract must be verified separately.

runtime.conclusion: A compatible binary must be located or built using scripts/atx-build.ps1 before real acceptance. Existing atx-impl file timestamp2026-09-19; not evidence of current-source acceptance.

release_bundling: Keep complete feature registry and panels; export explicitly selected <=64field consumer bundles, with all excluded fields and reasons retained.
required_evidence: representative downstream command and exit/result hashes
negative tests for changed sources, axes and unsupported PIT fields
